messages:
Morgan: Quick design review — posted the updated model browser mock in the Figma link. Main changes: a collapsible compact list view option, a new perf sparkline column, and a small "Freeze version" toggle next to the model name. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123 (screens). :eyes: Asking for quick accessibility + copy pass before I push prototypes.

Devon: Nice visual direction. Quick nits: contrast on the green sparkline is borderline — needs to meet 4.5:1 against the panel bg. Also the Freeze toggle has no visible focus state in the mock; keyboard users need a clear ring. :exclamation:

Isabel: Copy thought: "Freeze version" sounds a bit heavy/ambiguous. Suggest either "Lock to version" or "Freeze model version" and a tooltip: "Lock model to this specific version to prevent automatic rollouts." Keep tooltip under 12 words.

Chris: Implementation notes: treat the sparkline as decorative for screen readers but expose a short textual summary via aria-label like: "Median 92ms, P95 320ms, trending down 5%". Also consider adding a P95 numeric column — easier to scan than tiny sparklines alone. If sparkline is decorative, still include an accessible title in the SVG.

Morgan: Good call. Also thinking about a density control: Comfortable / Compact / Touch (3-way). Default to Comfortable on desktop; Touch for mobile. And make the compare checkbox sticky in the header so people can multi-select while scrolling.

Devon: Keyboard nav proposal: arrow keys move rows, space toggles selection, Enter opens details, and maybe "f" toggles Freeze. Announce Freeze state changes via aria-live="polite". Ensure freeze toggle has aria-pressed and a meaningful label.

Isabel: Accessibility extras: use a colorblind-friendly palette for sparklines and badges. For extra clarity add text labels on badges (e.g., "ok", "degraded") so screen readers aren’t relying on color. Also provide a high-contrast toggle in the user settings.

Chris: Microcopy tweak: replace generic "Perf" badge header with either "Latency (P95)" or "Latency trend" depending on column content. Tooltip copy should be single-sentence and actionable.

Morgan: I'll update the Figma and open a light PR that includes: copy changes (Lock to version), a11y checklist (focus states, aria labels, aria-live), and the density toggle mock. Any objections to using "Lock to version"? If no objections, I'll swap wording across the mocks.

Isabel: +1 to "Lock to version" — clearer intent.

design-bot: Preview build created: https://preview.redwood.dev/changes/1788 — includes compact list + density switch. Automated a11y scan reports two contrast failures on the current palette (see PR comments).

Devon: Thanks — will follow up with a quick contrast-friendly palette proposal and a tiny keyboard interaction spec tomorrow.

Morgan: Great, thanks all. I’ll iterate and tag you in the PR when ready. :sparkles:
